{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The dense colored object is a rectangle; scattered non-background pixels are distractors.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row) - {bg}
    best = None
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
        inside=sum(grid[r][c]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
        # Favor compact, nearly filled rectangular object over scattered marks.
        score=(inside/area, inside, area)
        if best is None or score > best[0]: best=(score,color,r0,r1,c0,c1)
    _,color,r0,r1,c0,c1=best
    return [[color if r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1 else bg for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
